name: RGB → YUV (BT.601)
description: First stage of composite video encoding: convert linear RGB to Y′UV (luma + chroma difference). BT.601 matrix used for standard-definition NTSC and PAL.

stages.name: Gamma Encoding
stages.description: Apply gamma curve to linear-light RGB (γ ≈ 2.2 for NTSC/PAL). Produces R′G′B′.

stages.name: BT.601 Colour Matrix
stages.description: Encode R′G′B′ to Y′ (luma), Cb/U (blue-difference chroma), Cr/V (red-difference chroma).
stages.note: U and V are offset by 0.5 to bring them into [0,1] range for display.

stages.name: Chroma Subsampling
stages.description: VHS does not transmit full 4:4:4; effective chroma is approximately 4:1:1 (NTSC) or 4:2:0 (PAL).
